help.memoryLimit: Maximum memory a script can allocate in bytes. Example: 2048M.
help.maxInputTime: Time to parse POST/GET data in seconds
help.postMaxSize: Maximum POST data size. Must be larger than upload_max_filesize.
help.displayErrors: Display errors in output (keep off in production)
help.includePath: Script include directories (separate with : on Linux)
help.openBasedir: Directories PHP can access (empty means unrestricted). Separate with :
help.mailForceExtraParameters: Additional parameters for the mail() function
help.pmMaxRequests: Requests before restarting a worker (prevents memory leaks)
